your_book:
Wednesday was a broadly constructive session for Jaleel's book, with the portfolio's overall unrealized gain sitting at 5.84%. Healthcare and software drove the day's gains. Danaher surged +5.97% — the session's biggest single-day mover — while Vertex Pharma (+4.52%), Novartis (+3.73%), Zoetis (+3.68%), and Adobe (+3.55%) all posted meaningful advances. AstraZeneca (+3.03%) and Boston Scientific (+3.05%) rounded out a strong day for the healthcare cluster. On the software side, Adobe and SAP both caught a tailwind from a Bank of America price-target upgrade cycle, with the analyst citing strong earnings, accelerating growth, and easing AI-disruption fears — directly relevant to Adobe's elevated risk flag. Abbott (+1.55%) held up quietly on its largest weight.

Two names pulled against the current. Rocket Lab fell -4.19%, deepening its position loss to -3.2%, and it remains the only AVOID-rated holding in the book — price and thesis are diverging in the wrong direction with no visible catalyst to close that gap. Broadcom dropped -4.61% on Fed-minutes hawkishness and OpenAI earnings anxiety, nudging its position loss to -4.2%; the semiconductor read-through also clipped NVIDIA (-0.99%), though that position remains in the green at +9.9% overall.

The drift worth watching: BSX is rated BUY and up +3.05% today, yet carries an elevated guidance-cut flag (FY26 growth slashed to 7–8.5%) with the next catalyst not until October 20 — price is recovering faster than the fundamental revision warrants. LULU is similarly a BUY verdict sitting on a -6.6% position loss with a guidance-cut flag and Americas comps down five straight quarters; the September 2 earnings date is the line in the sand.

attention.headline: Only AVOID-rated name, deepening loss with no thesis support
attention.note: Rocket Lab is down -3.2% on the position, carries the book's lowest QARP score (37.1), is rated AVOID, and fell another -4.19% today — the gap between its verdict and its continued presence in the book needs a deliberate decision.

attention.headline: Guidance-cut flag, -6.6% position loss, earnings September 2
attention.note: Five straight quarters of negative Americas comps, tariff margin pressure, and a stalled China business mean the September 2 print is a binary event — the BUY verdict needs to hold up against what could be another guide-down.

attention.headline: -4.61% today on Fed hawkishness and AI-capex doubt, position now -4.2%
attention.note: Broadcom's session drop was driven by the same macro forces (higher-for-longer rates, OpenAI earnings uncertainty) that also pressured NVDA — if AI-capex sentiment deteriorates further, this small but loss-making position faces additional headwinds before any catalyst.

attention.headline: Earnings August 26 — export controls and AI-capex sentiment in focus
attention.note: At 9.3% weight, NVDA is among the book's largest positions; the August 26 print arrives against a backdrop of China export-license tightening and Senate scrutiny, making it the nearest high-stakes catalyst in the portfolio.
